main.description: A 花粉撲滅 remediation verdict for a forest STAND, computed on read from its disclosed facts (ADR-2606211712). 撲滅 = ecological RESTORATION (主伐再造林), NEVER deforestation-for-profit. ASSESSMENT + R0 DESIGN ONLY — kafun never cuts and never plants; live forestry is the landowner's + operator/Council step. A restoration worklist entry, NEVER a cut-list item (G1/G2/G5).

stand.description: stand id (e.g. kafun-stand:sugi-tama-a). A forest stand — a pollen SOURCE or a 主伐再造林 candidate; NEVER a person (G2).

species.description: スギ/ヒノキ = the cedar/cypress pollen sources; broadleaf = negligible pollen

prefecture.description: coarse region tag (aggregate; no parcel coordinates, G2)

pollenBurden.description: edge-primary pollen-source concentration ×1000 (fixed-point): min(1,area-ha/10000)·emission-density·(0.5+0.5·exposed-pop-weight), scored on read

remediationPriority.description: ranking aid ×1000 (fixed-point): burden·reforest-viability·consent-weight. A ranking aid; the verdict is the gate's, not this number.

verdict.description: the remediation gate's decision (hard refusals precede every route)

reason.description: refusal reason (G1/G4) — present only when verdict = :refuse. 主伐 without 再造林 OR net-positive carbon.

route.description: downstream route — 主伐再造林 (L3-1) / 無花粉苗木 (L1-1) / gradual-selective (protected, never 皆伐)

computedOnRead.description: the verdict is a transient integral of the stand's disclosed facts, not stored ground state (edge-primary)

isCutList.description: G1/G2 — a remediation MAP is never a cut-list / target-list; this record routes a stand for RESTORATION

neverActuates.description: G5 — kafun never cuts and never plants; :kafun/actuate / :kafun/clearcut are unrepresentable. Even :reforest-priority is design-only.

sourcing.description: R0 seed is :synthetic; real cadastral/satellite-derived stands are an operator/Council step (G7)
